ani-atk.name: ATK
ani-atk.desc: Wields the power of fire to attack targets at close range.

ani-fire-kick.name: Fire Kick
ani-fire-kick.desc: Jumps up to dodge an attack, allowing flames to swirl around it before diving down and dealing damage to targets around the landing point. A successful dodge also deals 120% damage and increases damage by 20% for 20s.

ani-pebble-kick.name: Pebble Kick
ani-pebble-kick.desc: Jumps up to dodge an attack, allowing broken stones to swirl around it before diving down and dealing damage to targets around the landing point. A successful dodge also deals 120% damage and inflicts [Lockdown] on hit targets for 8s.

ani-fire-bolt.name: Fire Bolt
ani-fire-bolt.desc: Launches a fireball at the target and applies 2 stacks of [Fire Debuff] for 5s. Hold the skill button to aim.

ani-falling-star.name: Falling Star
ani-falling-star.desc: Jumps up and slams down with a flame-encircled fist, dealing damage to a large area.

ani-burn-breaker.name: Burn Breaker
ani-burn-breaker.desc: After charging, unleashes a powerful blast forward, dealing damage. At max charge, consumes all remaining EP. For every extra 10 EP consumed, deals 30% extra damage.

ani-lightning-kick.name: Lightning Kick
ani-lightning-kick.desc: Jumps up to dodge an attack, allowing lightning to swirl around it before diving down and dealing damage to targets around the landing point. A successful dodge also deals 120% damage and inflicts Paralysis on hit targets for 5s.

ani-wolfpack-onslaught.name: Wolfpack Onslaught
ani-wolfpack-onslaught.desc: Summons a soul clone to perform a forward Tackle. Upon hitting a target, it explodes, dealing damage.

ani-blazing-wolf-assault.name: Blazing Wolf Assault
ani-blazing-wolf-assault.desc: Summons 2 clones to attack the selected location. Summons 1 extra clone that gains [Super Armor] for 10s while in the [Full Energy] state.

ani-hunting-pack.name: Hunting Pack
ani-hunting-pack.desc: Summons 2 clones to attack the selected location. Summons 1 extra clone while in the [Full Energy] state.

ani-crossfire.name: Crossfire
ani-crossfire.desc: Fires a flame ray that penetrates targets and deals up to 9 hits of damage. While [Full Energy] is active, Might increases by 45%.

ani-unbroken-flameruff-spirit.name: Unbroken Flameruff Spirit
ani-unbroken-flameruff-spirit.desc: Fires a Flameruff Spirit that ricochets between targets, increasing BREAK efficiency against them by 10% per stack, up to 3 stacks, for 20s. Ricochets 5 times by default. While in the [Full Energy] state, ricochets 7 times.

ani-shooting-stars.name: Shooting Stars
ani-shooting-stars.desc: Shoots stars to attack a target, dealing damage.

ani-star-glide.name: Star Glide
ani-star-glide.desc: Flies overhead, dropping stars that damage targets. Hitting the same target 3 times increases this Aniimo’s EP recovery rate by 10% for 10s.

ani-comet-aureus.name: Comet Aureus
ani-comet-aureus.desc: Summons a large number of comets from the sky to attack a target, dealing a huge amount of damage.

ani-shadow-magic.name: Shadow Magic
ani-shadow-magic.desc: Immediately breaks free of control effects and retreats from the target, leaving a clone behind for 20s. The clone cannot be attacked and mimics the user’s basic attacks and skills, dealing damage equal to 20% of the user’s damage. Use the skill again to swap places with the clone. The clone is destroyed if it moves more than 20m away from the user.

ani-chill-glide.name: Chill Glide
ani-chill-glide.desc: Flies while dropping Ice element stars to attack the target for damage. Every 1 hits on a target applies 1 stack of Ice Debuff. After maintaining the skill state for 4s, can attack while moving for 15s.

ani-shooting-star-glide.name: Shooting Star Glide
ani-shooting-star-glide.desc: Flies while dropping stars to attack the target for damage. Hitting the same target 3 times increases the Aniimo’s Energy recovery speed by 10% for 10s. After maintaining the skill state for 4s, can attack while moving for 15s.

ani-shooting-stars-40.name: Shooting Stars
ani-shooting-stars-40.desc: Fires 3 homing stars. Each time a star damages a target, the user gains a 1% Damage Boost, stacking up to 15 times.

ani-aquatic-glide.name: Aquatic Glide
ani-aquatic-glide.desc: Flies while dropping Water element stars to attack the target for damage. Each hit reduces the target’s Energy by 3. After maintaining the skill state for 4s, can attack while moving for 15s.

ani-leaf-tornado.name: Leaf Tornado
ani-leaf-tornado.desc: Releases a leaf vortex at the target location, dealing damage and pulling enemies toward the center. Continuously absorbs puddles nearby, dealing 100% extra damage upon successful absorption.

ani-tornado-wind-orb.name: Tornado Wind Orb
ani-tornado-wind-orb.desc: Launches a tornado wind orb that explodes on impact and generates a forward-propelling tornado.

ani-march.name: March
ani-march.desc: Plays music and gains the movement-series buff: [March], restoring 0.8% max HP every second for 20s. With 3 movement-series buffs active, all effects from those buffs are increased by 30%.

ani-water-tornado.name: Water Tornado
ani-water-tornado.desc: Releases a water vortex at the target location, dealing damage and pulling enemies toward the center. Each hit deducts 4 Energy from the target.

ani-tornado.name: Tornado
ani-tornado.desc: Releases an air vortex at the target location, dealing damage and pulling enemies toward the center.

ani-zephyr-s-breath.name: Zephyr’s Breath
ani-zephyr-s-breath.desc: Deals Wind damage over a large area and increases all party members’ Wind damage by 25% for 30s.

ani-spiral-blade.name: Spiral Blade
ani-spiral-blade.desc: Fires a Wind Bomb at the target, dealing damage. After 1s, a second explosion erupts around the hit target, dealing additional AoE damage equal to 30% of the original Might. The second explosion reduces the Wind Resistance of hit targets by 3%, up to 5 stacks, for 20s.

ani-waltz.name: Waltz
ani-waltz.desc: Plays music and gains the movement-series buff: [Waltz], increasing Crit Damage by 27% for 20s. With 3 movement-series buffs active, all effects from those buffs are increased by 30%.

ani-avian-harmony-ensemble.name: Avian Harmony Ensemble
ani-avian-harmony-ensemble.desc: Fires a powerful wind-type beam at the target. If you have all three Movements equipped, the attack’s area of effect expands.

ani-lightning-splitter.name: Lightning Splitter
ani-lightning-splitter.desc: Fires multiple Electric Projectiles at nearby targets. If multiple projectiles hit the same unit, [paralyzes] the target for 5s. Hold the skill button to automatically enter the Fly state after the skill is cast.

ani-wind-bomb-rush.name: Wind Bomb Rush
ani-wind-bomb-rush.desc: Goes all out, rapidly firing a continuous barrage of Wind Bombs.

ani-scream-splitter.name: Scream Splitter
ani-scream-splitter.desc: Fires multiple Screech Rounds at nearby targets. If multiple projectiles hit the same unit, Cornet’s damage increases by 30% for 15s. Hold the Skill button to automatically enter the Fly state after the skill is cast.

ani-truce.name: Truce
ani-truce.desc: Creates a field that continuously grants allies within range 35% damage reduction for 7s.

ani-resting-whirlwind.name: Resting Whirlwind
ani-resting-whirlwind.desc: Flaps its wings to fire 2 arcing whirlwinds, pulling targets along their paths. When the whirlwinds meet, they explode and deal AoE damage.

ani-gale-guard.name: Gale Guard
ani-gale-guard.desc: Assumes a defensive stance and gains 20% Damage Reduction. When the defensive stance ends, gains a shield equal to 10% max HP for 20s. press the skill again to end it early. While in the defensive stance, each hit taken increases the shield gained by 10%, up to 100%.

ani-floral-storm.name: Floral Storm
ani-floral-storm.desc: Spins while moving and releases magical petals that track targets. The number of petals released increases by 1 over time, up to 3 at once. Press the skill again to stop casting.

ani-vortex-of-petals.name: Vortex of Petals
ani-vortex-of-petals.desc: Generates a large vortex of petals at the feet of the target to attack it.

ani-dancing-petals.name: Dancing Petals
ani-dancing-petals.desc: Spins and releases a storm of petals to attack a target.

ani-focused-beam.name: Focused Beam
ani-focused-beam.desc: Fires an energy beam at targets ahead. After gaining 24 points of [Dance Power], the next skill cast has a larger range.

ani-healing-water.name: Healing Water
ani-healing-water.desc: Restores all allies’ HP by an amount equal to 8% of the caster’s max HP, and restores HP to the caster equal to 10% of their max HP over 5s.

ani-water-orb.name: Water Orb
ani-water-orb.desc: Shoots Water Orbs to attack a target. Press and hold the skill button to aim.

ani-ice-orb.name: Ice Orb
ani-ice-orb.desc: Fires an Ice Orb at the target, putting the target into a [Frozen] state for 2.5s. Hold the skill key to aim.

ani-spring-of-life.name: Spring of Life
ani-spring-of-life.desc: Creates a circular water zone at a fixed location. While within the area, allies are healed for 36% of the caster’s Max HP over 6s.

ani-glimmer-shot.name: Glimmer Shot
ani-glimmer-shot.desc: Shoots a Light Orb to attack the target. On hit, increases the whole team’s damage by 15% for 20s. Press and hold the skill button to aim.

ani-bubble-rush.name: Bubble Rush
ani-bubble-rush.desc: Spits bubbles to attack a target. Press and hold the skill button to keep spitting, continuously consuming EP and dealing damage to all targets hit.

ani-lotus-bloom.name: Lotus Bloom
ani-lotus-bloom.desc: Quickly forms a lotus cocoon that bursts open, instantly healing the whole team for 15% of the caster’s max HP, and grants the entire team 15% Grass Elemental Boost for 30s.

ani-vitality-blooms.name: Vitality Blooms
ani-vitality-blooms.desc: Creates a circular magic field underfoot, restoring 2.4 EP every second to Grass-type teammates within range for 12s. The field also upgrades nearby Turf into Vitality Blooms, restoring 1% HP every second to Grass-type teammates within range.

ani-cyclone-of-leaves.name: Cyclone of Leaves
ani-cyclone-of-leaves.desc: Swipes its tail and releases a forward-moving cyclone of leaves to attack targets. Turf is formed around the Aniimo and along the cyclone's path for 20s.

ani-vine-entanglement.name: Vine Entanglement
ani-vine-entanglement.desc: Launches a circular magic attack around the target. If affected targets are on grass, they are bound by vines and enter a [Stunned] state for 3s.

ani-cloud-orb.name: Cloud Orb
ani-cloud-orb.desc: Throws a missile condensed from clouds at the target. If the user is [Shrouded in Mist], the missile creates a larger explosion on hit, dealing damage equal to 180% Might.

ani-thunder-bolt.name: Thunder Bolt
ani-thunder-bolt.desc: Tosses projectiles formed from thunderclouds to attack the targets. When in the [Shrouded in Mist] state, the projectiles will explode after hitting targets, dealing damage equal to 120% Might and inflicting [Paralysis] on the targets for 5s.

ani-cloud-shield.name: Cloud Shield
ani-cloud-shield.desc: Creates a cloud shield to protect itself, absorbing damage up to 15% max HP and reducing stamina consumption by 15% for 20s. While affected by [Shrouded in Mist], the shield absorbs damage up to 18% max HP instead, and stamina consumption is reduced by 18% for 30s.

ani-collectible-drop.name: Collectible Drop
ani-collectible-drop.desc: Turbo sneezes, shaking 7 collectibles out of its wool. Picking up a collectible restores 6% HP.

ani-nimbi-burst.name: Nimbi Burst
ani-nimbi-burst.desc: Inhales to trigger an explosion that deals AoE damage. Increases the entire team’s damage and BREAK efficiency by 15% for 20s. If the user is [Shrouded in Mist], the damage and BREAK efficiency boost also applies to all nearby allies, with the boost increased to 30%.

ani-nebula-burst.name: Nebula Burst
ani-nebula-burst.desc: Inhales, then slams the ground, triggering an explosion that deals AoE damage in a circular area around itself. Increases party members’ Dark damage by 15% for 20s. If the user is [Shrouded in Mist], the Dark damage boost also applies to all nearby allies, with the boost increased to 30%.

ani-dream-blast.name: Dream Blast
ani-dream-blast.desc: Deals damage to targets in range and applies 2 stacks of [Drowsiness]. Increases the whole team’s Dark damage by 20% for 30s.

ani-nimbi-attack.name: Nimbi Attack
ani-nimbi-attack.desc: Summons a Nimbi that follows the caster, damaging targets in its path and applying 1 stack of [Drowsiness]. When hitting the caster, the Nimbi charges back toward the target.

ani-nightmare-devourer.name: Nightmare Devourer
ani-nightmare-devourer.desc: Restores 5% HP to this Aniimo and nearby allies, then absorbs [Nightmare] from nearby targets. Each absorbed [Nightmare] status increases healing by 2%, up to 3 stacks.

ani-hypnotic-cloud-shot.name: Hypnotic Cloud Shot
ani-hypnotic-cloud-shot.desc: Fires a Hypnotic Cloud Shot at the target. After it explodes, it deals damage to targets in the area and applies 1 stack of Drowsiness.

ani-gravel-tackle.name: Gravel Tackle
ani-gravel-tackle.desc: Rams into the target with its body, dealing Earth damage.

ani-euphoric-sonic-blast.name: Euphoric Sonic Blast
ani-euphoric-sonic-blast.desc: Lets out a special scream, dealing damage to enemies in a frontal cone and restoring 10 energy.

ani-plant-charge.name: Plant Charge
ani-plant-charge.desc: Rams into the target with the body.

ani-annihilation-bomb.name: Annihilation Bomb
ani-annihilation-bomb.desc: Gathers annihilation energy in the palm and hurls it toward the target, dealing massive AoE damage.

ani-malicious-outburst.name: Malicious Outburst
ani-malicious-outburst.desc: Releases a wide-area energy burst around the target, dealing damage to targets hit and reducing subsequent shield values gained by 44% for 20s.

ani-euphoric-sonic-blast-36.name: Euphoric Sonic Blast
ani-euphoric-sonic-blast-36.desc: Lets out a special scream, piercing all enemies ahead and restoring 10 Energy.

ani-shard-impact.name: Shard Impact
ani-shard-impact.desc: Quickly steps back while leaving an Earthen sigil beneath the target—shrapnel continuously launches from the sigil to strike and Stun them for 2s.

ani-black-hole-domain.name: Black Hole Domain
ani-black-hole-domain.desc: Quickly backsteps a short distance, leaving a black hole beneath the target that continuously pulls the target in and deals damage.

ani-oozing-malice.name: Oozing Malice
ani-oozing-malice.desc: Releases an energy shock wave around the target, dealing damage to enemies hit and reducing their healing received by 44% for 20s.

ani-breaking-roar.name: Breaking Roar
ani-breaking-roar.desc: Restores Hummin units to their maximum number, then roars with them to release a massive shockwave at the target.

ani-draw-nourishment.name: Draw Nourishment
ani-draw-nourishment.desc: Roots itself firmly in the soil, granting self and Hummin 20% BREAK efficiency.Instantly restores 50% HP to all Hummins, and heals self and nearby Hummins for 2% HP every second.

ani-haunting-choir.name: Haunting Choir
ani-haunting-choir.desc: Causes all Hummins to blink next to the target and unleash sonic attacks, dealing area damage and inflicting [Stun] for 1s.

ani-noisy-strikes.name: Noisy Strikes
ani-noisy-strikes.desc: Teleports all Hummin units next to the target to unleash Gravel Tackle, dealing damage.

ani-off-key-shock-wave.name: Off-Key Shock Wave
ani-off-key-shock-wave.desc: Teleports all Hummins next to the target and unleashes a Tackle attack, dealing damage.

ani-the-luminus-gust.name: The Luminus Gust
ani-the-luminus-gust.desc: Spins Cores around itself, continuously dealing damage and applying [Earth Debuff] for 5.5s.

ani-verdant-beam.name: Verdant Beam
ani-verdant-beam.desc: Fires an energy beam in the direction the camera is facing, continuously dealing damage to targets within range. Consecutive hits gradually increase its Might.

ani-leaf-slash.name: Leaf Slash
ani-leaf-slash.desc: Spins leaves around itself, dealing damage for 5.5s.

ani-quake-impact.name: Quake Impact
ani-quake-impact.desc: Bursts out of the ground, causing shock waves across a large area.

ani-charged-blow.name: Charged Blow
ani-charged-blow.desc: Raises its pincers to charge. When fully charged or when the skill is cast again, performs 2 quick swings. Can move while charging.

ani-freezing-claws.name: Freezing Claws
ani-freezing-claws.desc: Deals damage over a large area.

ani-ice-spikes.name: Ice Spikes
ani-ice-spikes.desc: Creates an ice spike ahead, attacking and [freezing] the target for 2.5s. Can be used during tunneling. Afterward, dashes forward and emerges from underground.

ani-icy-gravel-dance.name: Icy Gravel Dance
ani-icy-gravel-dance.desc: Summons an Ice Storm that continuously builds up [Ice Debuff] on targets. The Ice Storm keeps moving forward until it hits a wall or a target.

ani-frost-slam.name: Frost Slam
ani-frost-slam.desc: Gathers icy vapor in both pincers, then slams them down to deal AoE damage in front and create an ice wall for 5s.

ani-trick-fire-ring.name: Trick Fire Ring
ani-trick-fire-ring.desc: Launches a fire ring that expands then contracts to attack the target. The farther the target is, the more damage it will take, up to 50% increased damage.

ani-fire-orb.name: Fire Orb
ani-fire-orb.desc: Throws an explosive fireball at the target. Press and hold to aim.

ani-phantom-flame-cannon.name: Phantom Flame Cannon
ani-phantom-flame-cannon.desc: Jumps up and throws a giant fireball at the target. It explodes on landing, dealing wide-area damage and applying 12 stacks of [Fire Debuff].

ani-phantom-barrage.name: Phantom Barrage
ani-phantom-barrage.desc: Slams all targets within range that are affected by [Fire Debuff] from a distance. Restores 3.2 EP for each stack of [Fire Debuff] on the target, up to 28.8 EP.

ani-purifying-dance.name: Purifying Dance
ani-purifying-dance.desc: Removes all debuffs on surrounding teammates. Once the debuffs are removed, increases their EP recovery rate by 20% for 10s.

ani-healing-dance.name: Healing Dance
ani-healing-dance.desc: Creates a warm wind area beneath the caster, continuously healing the entire team for 9% of the caster’s Max HP over 8s. Aniimo within the area also gain 40% BREAK damage reduction.

ani-phantom-dance.name: Phantom Dance
ani-phantom-dance.desc: Removes debuffs from the caster. When off-field, Gracewing automatically appears to remove debuffs from the active teammate.

ani-wind-of-rejuvenation.name: Wind of Rejuvenation
ani-wind-of-rejuvenation.desc: Creates a warm wind area beneath the feet, continuously healing the entire team for 9% of the caster’s Max HP over 8s. Wind-type Aniimo receive an additional 3% healing.

ani-wind-of-regeneration.name: Wind of Regeneration
ani-wind-of-regeneration.desc: Grants allies within the target area a shield equal to 12% of the caster’s Max HP for 20s.

ani-help-gracewing.name: Help! Gracewing!
ani-help-gracewing.desc: Instantly heals the whole team for 30% of the caster’s max HP.

ani-phantomfly.name: Phantomfly
ani-phantomfly.desc: Creates a Phantomfly at the location, restoring 20 EP to all teammates that touch it after a 3s delay. There can be up to 2 Phantomflies at the same time.

ani-butterfly-dance.name: Butterfly Dance
ani-butterfly-dance.desc: The Somniwing flies up and uses its power of rejuvenation, recovering 36 EP.

ani-hypnotic-spores.name: Hypnotic Spores
ani-hypnotic-spores.desc: On hit, puts the target into [Sleeping], increasing damage taken by the target by 25% and preventing action for 5s. Removed when the target takes damage. Ineffective against Grass-type Aniimo.

ani-energy-orb.name: Energy Orb
ani-energy-orb.desc: Charges and gathers Energy above the target, then drops it to strike the target. Hold the Skill button to charge. Every 0.6s, consumes 10 Energy to increase the skill damage, up to 4 times. Stages 1 to 5 deal damage equal to 1/2/3/4.5/6x Might, respectively.

ani-ethereal-light-wave.name: Ethereal Light Wave
ani-ethereal-light-wave.desc: Sends a light wave forward, absorbing enemy projectiles and increasing EP recovery rate by 24% for teammates along its path for 20s.

ani-sonar-attack.name: Sonar Attack
ani-sonar-attack.desc: Fires a Sonar Attack in a cone, dealing damage 10 times to targets within range. The final hit applies Weakness Mark, reducing the Crit Resistance Rate of targets hit by 12% for 5s.

ani-arc-strike.name: Arc Strike
ani-arc-strike.desc: Performs an arc-shaped sweep. Enemies hit while affected by [Weakness Mark] are also [stunned] for 2.5s.

ani-target-weakness.name: Target Weakness
ani-target-weakness.desc: Applies Weakness Mark to all targets within view range for 30s. Also reduces targets’ Wind Resistance by 20% for 30s.

ani-detect-weakness.name: Detect Weakness
ani-detect-weakness.desc: Uses its tail amplifier to continuously emit sonar, detecting the weak points of targets within range. Keeping the target’s Weakness at the center for 0.8s applies Weakness Mark to it, reducing its CRIT resistance by 12% for 20s.

ani-tactical-kick.name: Tactical Kick
ani-tactical-kick.desc: Quickly charges toward the target, performs a backflip kick to deal damage, then jumps back to the initial position, reducing the Movement Speed of the target hit by 30% for 10s.

ani-thorny-defense.name: Thorny Defense
ani-thorny-defense.desc: Enters a defensive stance, reducing damage taken by 20%. While in this state, it counters when attacked. If attacked just as the skill is used, its Crit Rate increases by 30% for 15s.

ani-thorny-impact.name: Thorny Impact
ani-thorny-impact.desc: Thrusts toward the target. On hit, increases this Aniimo’s Crit Rate by 15% for 15s.

ani-elegant-waltz.name: Elegant Waltz
ani-elegant-waltz.desc: Repeatedly stabs a target with its thorn blade.

ani-aqua-defense.name: Aqua Defense
ani-aqua-defense.desc: Enters a defensive stance, reducing damage taken by 20%. If attacked during the stance, counterattacks the target. If attacked at the moment the skill is cast, applies [Lockdown] to the target for 12s.

ani-lightning-impact.name: Lightning Impact
ani-lightning-impact.desc: Thrusts toward the target. On hit, increases this Aniimo’s Crit Rate by 15% for 15s.

ani-thorny-rain.name: Thorny Rain
ani-thorny-rain.desc: Rapidly attacks the target with its thorn blade. Can be used up to 3 times in a row.

ani-rose-garden.name: Rose Garden
ani-rose-garden.desc: Creates a magic circle beneath itself. Allies within range gain 70% increased Grass Crit Damage for 30s.

ani-thorny-blessing.name: Thorny Blessing
ani-thorny-blessing.desc: Grants Thorny Blessing to the whole team. When dealing Grass Crit Damage to a target, creates thorns beneath it that deal damage. Triggers up to 1 time every 0.5s for 15s.

ani-healing-rose.name: Healing Rose
ani-healing-rose.desc: Summons a rose that explodes and applies Rose Mark to the target. Rose Mark blooms after the target takes 3 critical hits, healing all nearby allies for 5% of Melloblum's HP.

ani-sparkling-rose.name: Sparkling Rose
ani-sparkling-rose.desc: Removes negative effects on the whole team and releases a Light element rose to track and attack the target. The skill has an additional 15% Crit Rate.

ani-blasting-roses.name: Blasting Roses
ani-blasting-roses.desc: Releases petals that track and attack the target. This skill gains 35% extra Crit Rate.

ani-frost-strike.name: Frost Strike
ani-frost-strike.desc: Strikes targets around itself. Targets hit enter a Frozen state for 2.5s.

ani-jittering-beats.name: Jittering Beats
ani-jittering-beats.desc: Strikes targets around itself. Targets hit enter a [Silence] state for 4s.

ani-rhythm-combo.name: Rhythm Combo
ani-rhythm-combo.desc: Performs a rhythmic combo on the target. Can be used up to 3 times in a row.Casting with the right timing adds 1 extra stack of [Volume].

ani-sonic-boom.name: Sonic Boom
ani-sonic-boom.desc: Unleashes a sonic blast around itself and instantly fills [Volume].

ani-wild-show.name: Wild Show
ani-wild-show.desc: Hold to charge the microphone, then release to unleash a massive sound wave, damaging targets in front. A well-timed release deals an additional 30% BREAK damage.

ani-blossoming-moment.name: Blossoming Moment
ani-blossoming-moment.desc: Jumps up to dodge an attack, allowing a scent to encircle itself before dive-pecking the targets to deal damage. A successful dodge will generate a shield equal to 10% of max HP for 20s.

ani-withering-bloom.name: Withering Bloom
ani-withering-bloom.desc: Releases a fragrance, dealing damage to targets within range and restoring HP to all team members equal to 5% of its own max HP. If there is only one target in range, the healing amount is doubled.

ani-fragrance-bomb.name: Fragrance Bomb
ani-fragrance-bomb.desc: Flaps its wings to release a fragrance, increasing Dark Elemental Boost for all team members by 20% for 30s. Also [charms] targets within range, leaving them dizzy for a short duration.

ani-withering-bloom-22.name: Withering Bloom
ani-withering-bloom-22.desc: Releases a fragrance, dealing damage to targets within range and restoring HP to all team members equal to 5% of its own max HP. If there is only one target in range, the healing amount is doubled.

ani-secret-fragrance-mark.name: Secret Fragrance Mark
ani-secret-fragrance-mark.desc: Deals damage to targets in front and applies Secret Fragrance for 20s. While the marks are active, Dark-type basic attacks deal 50% extra damage to the targets.

ani-scythe-dance.name: Scythe Dance
ani-scythe-dance.desc: Spins to slash, dealing Dark damage 4 times to all nearby targets. Each hit increases own damage by 4%, up to 32%, for 10s.

ani-forest-whirl.name: Forest Whirl
ani-forest-whirl.desc: Spins to slash, dealing Grass damage 4 times to all nearby targets. Each hit increases own damage by 4%, up to 32%, for 10s.

ani-dark-dash.name: Dark Dash
ani-dark-dash.desc: Tackles the target with the power of shadows, increasing basic attack damage by 40% for 10s after casting.

ani-dimension-rupture.name: Dimension Rupture
ani-dimension-rupture.desc: Cleaves through space, dealing heavy Physical damage.

ani-dark-soul.name: Dark Soul
ani-dark-soul.desc: Transports itself to a target and attacks. If the target has less than 50% HP left, for each 1% HP lost, increases the Aniimo’s damage by 1%. Defeating a target with this skill grants a time-limited free recast.

ani-fire-dash.name: Fire Dash
ani-fire-dash.desc: Tackles the target with the power of flame. After casting the skill, gains [Super Armor] for 5s.

ani-ice-strikes.name: Ice Strikes
ani-ice-strikes.desc: Lunges forward and spins to create a magic field that fires 3 ice blades for 3 hits, dealing damage and applying 5 stacks of [Ice Debuff].

ani-night-slash.name: Night Slash
ani-night-slash.desc: Steps forward and spins to release 3 shadow blades, dealing damage and [silencing] the target for 4s.

ani-boomerang-blade.name: Boomerang Blade
ani-boomerang-blade.desc: Throws an ice blade forward, dealing damage to targets in range and applying stacks of [Ice Debuff]. The ice blade continuously consumes energy while spinning, and pressing the Skill button again recalls it.

ani-ice-tornado.name: Ice Tornado
ani-ice-tornado.desc: Turns into an icy tornado to continuously attack its targets.

ani-frost-tail-strike.name: Frost Tail Strike
ani-frost-tail-strike.desc: Flips forward toward the target and slams the ground with a tail strike, dealing damage. Can consume 10 stacks of [Ice Debuff] to deal 85% extra damage.

ani-prismana-slash.name: Prismana Slash
ani-prismana-slash.desc: Lunges forward and spins to create a magic field that fires 3 light blades for 3 hits, dealing damage.

ani-high-voltage-dash.name: High-Voltage Dash
ani-high-voltage-dash.desc: While electrified, charges toward the target to deal damage.

ani-thunder-tail.name: Thunder Tail
ani-thunder-tail.desc: Channels the power of lightning, swinging its tail to attack targets ahead. This skill grants 50% additional Crit Rate.

ani-lightning-flash.name: Lightning Flash
ani-lightning-flash.desc: Leaps up at high speed, gathers electricity, then slams down onto the target and enters the [Overcharged] state.

ani-lightning-cross.name: Lightning Cross
ani-lightning-cross.desc: Channels the power of lightning, sending a lightning claw mark surging forward that deals up to 3 hits to the target. This skill grants an additional 50% CRIT Rate.

ani-electrified-impact.name: Electrified Impact
ani-electrified-impact.desc: Dashes toward the target with electricity and cannot be blocked during the dash. Restores 5 EP when landing a critical hit.

ani-dark-claw.name: Dark Claw
ani-dark-claw.desc: Unleashes consecutive Dark claw strikes on the target, dealing damage and [silencing] the target for 4s.

ani-lightning-claw.name: Lightning Claw
ani-lightning-claw.desc: Channels the power of lightning and strikes the target with a three-hit claw combo. This skill grants an additional 50% CRIT Rate.

ani-heavy-tail-strike.name: Heavy Tail Strike
ani-heavy-tail-strike.desc: Throws a punch forward. If the target hit has a [Pinecone] Mark, consumes the Mark to deal 50% more damage, launch the target, and stuns it for [Stun]2.5s.

ani-pinecone-bomb.name: Pinecone Bomb
ani-pinecone-bomb.desc: Throws a flaming pinecone that bursts on impact, scattering an additional 3 pinecone fragments in all directions. Targets hit are marked with [Pinecone].

ani-blazing-rush.name: Blazing Rush
ani-blazing-rush.desc: Squashel’s tail sparks with fire, whipping up cascading flames from the ground to deal heavy damage to the target.

ani-blazing-fist-barrage.name: Blazing Fist Barrage
ani-blazing-fist-barrage.desc: Throws a two-hit punch forward. If the target hit carries the Pinecone mark, consumes the mark and empowers the next basic attack into [Punch Rush].[Punch Rush]: Continuously throws punches forward, dealing damage equal to 60 Might.

ani-water-cannon.name: Water Cannon
ani-water-cannon.desc: Jumps up and hurls a huge water ball at the target, dealing AoE damage and creating a puddle.

ani-water-dash.name: Water Dash
ani-water-dash.desc: Dashes at the target, dealing damage and knocking them back.

ani-wrath-of-the-sea.name: Wrath of the Sea
ani-wrath-of-the-sea.desc: Summons a huge wave toward the target to deal damage. Also increases Water Elemental Boost for party members by 20% for 30s.

ani-water-cannon-39.name: Water Cannon
ani-water-cannon-39.desc: Jumps up and hurls a huge water ball at the target, dealing AoE damage and creating a puddle.

ani-surge.name: Surge
ani-surge.desc: Restores HP to the entire team based on 4% of the Aniimo’s max HP. If within 10m of a water environment, absorbs water to boost healing—each puddle absorbed doubles the healing, up to 4 puddles at once.

ani-dark-tide.name: Dark Tide
ani-dark-tide.desc: Gains 15% BREAK Damage Reduction for 20s. If within 10m of a water environment, absorbs water to gain additional stacks of the effect—each puddle absorbed grants one additional stack, up to 4 puddles at once.

ani-surf.name: Surf
ani-surf.desc: Summons a wave underfoot, rides it toward the target to deal damage, and creates 4 puddles.

ani-home-run.name: Home Run
ani-home-run.desc: Swings the shovel with full force to deliver a powerful strike, dealing damage.

ani-water-cannonade.name: Water Cannonade
ani-water-cannonade.desc: Jumps up and hurls a huge water ball at the target, dealing AoE damage, creating a water puddle, and applying 5 stacks of Water Debuff to targets hit.

ani-hydro-roll.name: Hydro Roll
ani-hydro-roll.desc: Rolls continuously to ram targets while draining stamina. If cast near a water environment, absorbs water to increase BREAK Efficiency by 30% for 15s.

ani-splash-shield.name: Splash Shield
ani-splash-shield.desc: Gains a Water Shield equal to 11% of max HP for 15s. While active, each skill hit deals one additional instance of skill damage to the target. Trigger interval: 0.5s.

ani-torrent-slam.name: Torrent Slam
ani-torrent-slam.desc: Throws a shell at the target. If there are nearby puddles, puddles within the hit area deal additional damage equal to 30% of the original Might and increase Damage Amp by 15% for 20s.

ani-hydro-roll-83.name: Hydro Roll
ani-hydro-roll-83.desc: Continuously consumes stamina to roll forward and ram targets, dealing damage and restoring stamina over time. Creates a puddle when the roll ends. Stamina can be restored this way at most once every 3s.

ani-torrent-blade.name: Torrent Blade
ani-torrent-blade.desc: Performs a wide-area slash. If near a water environment, absorbs water to greatly increase the slash range, deal additional damage equal to {0}% Might, and increase basic attack range after the slash for {1}s.

ani-flowing-water-slash.name: Flowing Water Slash
ani-flowing-water-slash.desc: Gathers water and unleashes 3 consecutive slashes. Hitting the target with all slashes triggers an additional powerful slash. When near a water environment, absorbs water and empowers the slashes into water blade slashes, dealing additional damage equal to 30% Might.

ani-prismana-slam.name: Prismana Slam
ani-prismana-slam.desc: Strikes the target with a shell. If near a water environment, absorbs water to expand the damage range, deals additional damage equal to {0}% Might, and gains [Super Armor] for 5s.

ani-thunder-slam.name: Thunder Slam
ani-thunder-slam.desc: Throws a shell at a target to deal damage. If near water terrain, absorbs water to expand the hit area and deal {0}% extra damage.

ani-mud-ball-drift.name: Mud Ball Drift
ani-mud-ball-drift.desc: Spins around to deal damage to a target in front. Each hit increases damage by 8% for 20s, stacking up to 4 times.

ani-mud-ball-slice.name: Mud Ball Slice
ani-mud-ball-slice.desc: Lifts a mud ball and rolls it at high speed, dealing damage to targets ahead.

ani-ice-ball-cutting.name: Ice Ball Cutting
ani-ice-ball-cutting.desc: Raises the ice ball and rolls forward, dealing a large amount of damage.

ani-mudwheel-ashburst.name: Mudwheel Ashburst
ani-mudwheel-ashburst.desc: Fires a gigantic mud ball forward. It crushes the target, then explodes.

ani-darkwheel-slash.name: Darkwheel Slash
ani-darkwheel-slash.desc: Lifts a mud ball and rolls it forward at high speed, dealing damage to enemies ahead and dealing 400% extra damage to shields.

ani-sandstorm-spin.name: Sandstorm Spin
ani-sandstorm-spin.desc: Spins around by continuously consuming EP, dealing damage. Deals 20% extra damage to BREAK targets. Spin speed gradually increases, raising damage frequency by up to 100% without increasing EP cost.

ani-boulder-blast.name: Boulder Blast
ani-boulder-blast.desc: Spins rapidly across the ground, pulling in debris before detonating violently. On explosion, deals AoE damage and generates 6 [Rock Piles] around the Bouldus.

ani-clay-ball.name: Clay Ball
ani-clay-ball.desc: Throws a clay ball in a straight line in the direction faced, dealing damage on hit and applying Disintegration.

ani-rock-tackle.name: Rock Tackle
ani-rock-tackle.desc: Charges briefly in place, then rushes at the target and slams into it, dealing damage and creating 4 [Rock Piles] around the target.

ani-ice-sphere.name: Ice Sphere
ani-ice-sphere.desc: Transforms into a ball that moves forward automatically for 15s. Direction can be adjusted. Hitting an enemy deals damage, while bouncing off a wall deals AoE damage equal to 15 Might to nearby targets. Jump is available in the Rolling Ball state, dealing AoE damage equal to 20 Might on landing. Jump cooldown: 5s.

ani-rolling-ball.name: Rolling Ball
ani-rolling-ball.desc: Transforms into a ball that moves forward automatically for 15s. Direction can be adjusted. Hitting an enemy deals damage, while bouncing off a wall deals AoE damage equal to 15 Might to nearby targets. Jump is available in the Rolling Ball state, dealing AoE damage equal to 20 Might on landing. Jump cooldown: 5s.

ani-thunder-field.name: Thunder Field
ani-thunder-field.desc: Generates a thunder field that follows the target. When a target within the thunder field is hit by a Lightning attack, it is hit by an additional Lightning attack and inflicted with Lightning Debuff. Lightning attacks can trigger this effect no more than once every 0.2s. The thunder field lasts for 8s.

ani-lightning-dart.name: Lightning Dart
ani-lightning-dart.desc: Launches a lightning dart at the target, dealing damage to all targets along the way while drawing them closer over time.

ani-thunderfeather-volley.name: Thunderfeather Volley
ani-thunderfeather-volley.desc: Transforms the lightning wrapped around both wings into 5 arrows and fires them at the target. If in Thunderwing Stance, fires 5 additional arrows and finally deals explosion damage equal to 20 Might.

ani-thunder-imprint.name: Thunder Imprint
ani-thunder-imprint.desc: Gains [Thunder Imprint]. While active, each hit against a target stores the damage dealt on the target. When the effect ends, all stored damage is dealt at once. Recasting the skill during this period triggers the stored damage early. Lasts 8s. If the target has 10 stacks of [Lightning Debuff], consumes them to deal an additional 100% damage.

ani-radiant-dart.name: Radiant Dart
ani-radiant-dart.desc: Launches a Radiant Dart at the target, continuously dealing damage to targets along its path. Each hit applies 1 stack of [Healing Reduction], up to 16 stacks. Each stack reduces healing received by 5% for 20s.

ani-ballistic-guard.name: Ballistic Guard
ani-ballistic-guard.desc: Enters the [Ballistic Guard] state, increasing the user’s damage reduction by 20% and greatly boosting interruption resistance. When attacked, releases a shock wave around the user that deals damage equal to 10 Might. This can trigger no more than once every 0.2s.

ani-guardbreak-slam.name: Guardbreak Slam
ani-guardbreak-slam.desc: Jumps up and smashes down on the target to deal damage. Up to three consecutive smashes are allowed, and the third smash will stun the target for 1s.

ani-guardbreak-smash.name: Guardbreak Smash
ani-guardbreak-smash.desc: Jumps up and smashes down on the target to deal damage. Up to three consecutive smashes are allowed, and the third smash will stun the target for 1s.

ani-ironclad-armament.name: Ironclad Armament
ani-ironclad-armament.desc: Lowers the mask and hardens the body, increasing EP recovery rate by 10% and dealing 30% extra damage to BREAK targets for 15s. During this effect, the Ultimate can be used again to unleash Dragon Slayer Strike, dealing heavy damage to targets ahead.

ani-weakening-smash.name: Weakening Smash
ani-weakening-smash.desc: Jumps up and smashes down on the target to deal damage. Up to three consecutive smashes are allowed, and the third smash will stun the target for 1s.

ani-elastic-sword.name: Elastic Sword
ani-elastic-sword.desc: Extends its arm and throws its sword at targets ahead. When the sword returns, it pulls common targets in front of itself.

ani-shadow-cut.name: Shadow Cut
ani-shadow-cut.desc: Curls into a ball and spins with a blade sticking out, dealing damage.

ani-weakening-slam.name: Weakening Slam
ani-weakening-slam.desc: Jumps up and smashes down on the target to deal damage. Up to three consecutive smashes are allowed, and the third smash will stun the target for 1s.

ani-heavy-slam.name: Heavy Slam
ani-heavy-slam.desc: Makes its hands grow huge and smashes the ground, dealing damage to all targets nearby.

ani-bouncy-sling.name: Bouncy Sling
ani-bouncy-sling.desc: Charges up in place and launches itself forward, dealing damage to the target hit and increasing its BREAK damage taken by 15% for 15s. If other targets are nearby after the hit, it ricochets to them up to {4} times. It can also ricochet to allies.

ani-ballistic-guard-52.name: Ballistic Guard
ani-ballistic-guard-52.desc: Turns into a ball and jumps high into the air, damaging targets at the landing point. Enters [Ballistic Guard], increasing own damage reduction by 20% and greatly enhancing anti-interruption. When attacked, releases a shockwave around self that deals damage equal to 10 Might. Interval: No less than 0.2s.

ani-wind-tackle.name: Wind Tackle
ani-wind-tackle.desc: Tackles and pushes small-sized targets. Increases own damage reduction by 15% for 10s.

ani-skyfall.name: Skyfall
ani-skyfall.desc: Flies up and dives down to hit the ground, dealing huge amount of damage.

ani-wind-counter.name: Wind Counter
ani-wind-counter.desc: Enters a defensive stance, increasing Damage Reduction by 30% and immediately counterattacking when hit. If attacked at the moment the skill is cast, additionally increases BREAK Efficiency by 20% for 10s and [stuns] the target for 1.5s.

ani-hot-breath.name: Hot Breath
ani-hot-breath.desc: Breathes powerful Lava Breath from the air, dealing damage to all targets within a large area in front and applying 8 stacks of [Fire Debuff].

ani-fiery-charge.name: Fiery Charge
ani-fiery-charge.desc: Charges at the target to deal damage. If used while flying, dives at the target and stops flying. On hit, gains a shield equal to 5% of max HP for 10s.

ani-flaming-claws.name: Flaming Claws
ani-flaming-claws.desc: Casts Flaming Claws at the target. A powerful claw strike can be cast again within 5s. Both 2 claw strikes can consume 2 stacks of [Fire Debuff] from the target to deal additional damage equal to 30% Might.

ani-gale-charge.name: Gale Charge
ani-gale-charge.desc: Rushes toward the target, dealing Damage. If used while in Fly state, dives at the target and ends Fly. During the charge, reflects incoming Projectile attacks.

ani-lava-breath.name: Lava Breath
ani-lava-breath.desc: Breathes fire forward, attacking targets and applying 8 stacks of [Fire Debuff].

ani-fanatic-clawing.name: Fanatic Clawing
ani-fanatic-clawing.desc: Claws the target up to 3 times. When the third hit lands, the next skill gains double [Rage].In the [Enraged] state, each hit applies 2 stacks of [Claw Mark], up to 6 stacks.

ani-earthquake.name: Earthquake
ani-earthquake.desc: Stomps the ground to shockwave-strike targets in front, dealing damage and clearing all Claw Mark effects on the target. Each stack of Claw Mark deals additional damage equal to 10% Might and inflicts 2s of stun.

ani-rock-smash.name: Rock Smash
ani-rock-smash.desc: Leaps high, immediately gains 100 [Rage], and becomes [Enraged], then crashes down with thunderous force, dealing delayed burst damage to targets around the impact point.

ani-claw-of-madness.name: Claw of Madness
ani-claw-of-madness.desc: Claws the target up to 3 times. When the third hit lands, the next skill grants double [Rage].When in the [Enraged] state, each hit applies 2 stacks of [Claw Mark], up to 6 stacks.

ani-critical-hit.name: Critical Hit
ani-critical-hit.desc: Strikes hard to deal high damage and remove all [Claw Mark] effects from the target. Each stack of [Claw Mark] deals additional damage equal to 10% of Might.

ani-earth-spikes.name: Earth Spikes
ani-earth-spikes.desc: Generates a line of stone spikes that extend forward, piercing all targets in their path.

ani-stone-shell.name: Stone Shell
ani-stone-shell.desc: Fires a stone shell at the target.

ani-fiery-punch.name: Fiery Punch
ani-fiery-punch.desc: Dashes forward with a punch, dealing damage and piercing through targets. Also removes all [Fire Debuff] stacks from the target. Each stack of [Fire Debuff] deals additional damage equal to 5% Might.

ani-lava-breath-35.name: Lava Breath
ani-lava-breath-35.desc: Sprays flames at the target in front, dealing damage over time and applying [Fire Debuff] to the target hit.

ani-burning-sun.name: Burning Sun
ani-burning-sun.desc: The crystals on its elbows erupt with magma energy, hurling a massive molten boulder that explodes to deal wide-area damage. Damage increases by 2% for each stack of [Fire Debuff] on the target.

ani-lava-punch.name: Lava Punch
ani-lava-punch.desc: Dashes forward with a punch, dealing damage and piercing through targets. Also removes all [Fire Debuff] stacks from the target. Each stack of [Fire Debuff] deals additional damage equal to 5% Might.

ani-magma-surge.name: Magma Surge
ani-magma-surge.desc: Drives both claws into the ground, causing underground crystals to erupt with magma. A cone of molten spikes surges forward, damaging targets. If it hits a target with more than 5 stacks of [Fire Debuff], it [stuns] them for 3.5s.

ani-dark-energy-surge.name: Dark Energy Surge
ani-dark-energy-surge.desc: Plunges both claws into the underground crystals, causing them to erupt and send a cone-shaped wave of Dark molten rock spikes surging forward. The spikes deal damage to targets and [stun] them for 2.5s.

ani-meteor-shower.name: Meteor Shower
ani-meteor-shower.desc: Unleashes all the energy stored in the minerals on its back into the sky, where it transforms into meteors that rain down on targets.

ani-seismic-wave.name: Seismic Wave
ani-seismic-wave.desc: Continuously releases shock waves, dealing damage every second for 8s.

ani-shielding-smoke.name: Shielding Smoke
ani-shielding-smoke.desc: Deploys a smokescreen that obscures vision. Targets cannot be aimed at through the smoke.

ani-rolling-mud-ball.name: Rolling Mud Ball
ani-rolling-mud-ball.desc: Kicks a mud ball forward, causing it to roll and deal AoE damage on impact. Hold to aim and lob it.

ani-devastation-cannon.name: Devastation Cannon
ani-devastation-cannon.desc: Unleashes a devastating strike. Overflowing energy remains in the crater, dealing continuous damage.

ani-cannon-mode.name: Cannon Mode
ani-cannon-mode.desc: Lowers its chassis and grips the ground. During this state, basic attacks are replaced with cannon fire that consumes EP and deals AoE damage.

ani-cozite-nest-sentry.name: Cozite Nest Sentry
ani-cozite-nest-sentry.desc: Launches Cozite to hover around itself. When a party member uses a Skill or Ultimate, Cozite performs a coordinated attack. Lasts 15s.

ani-swift-retreat.name: Swift Retreat
ani-swift-retreat.desc: Quickly retreats, leaving behind a jellyfish clone that releases a Lightning Discharge to attack targets and slow them by 15% for 10s.

ani-lightning-discharge.name: Lightning Discharge
ani-lightning-discharge.desc: Fires an energy beam. Hold the skill button to keep firing, damaging targets within range and healing Lightning-type teammates within range for 2% HP every second.

ani-self-destruction.name: Self-Destruction
ani-self-destruction.desc: Continuously increases its voltage and eventually triggers an explosion, dealing wide-area damage and creating an electric field underfoot. Inside the field, Lightning Elemental Boost increases by 20% for 30s.

ani-healing-impact.name: Healing Impact
ani-healing-impact.desc: Fires an energy beam. Hold the skill key to keep firing, dealing damage to enemies in range and restoring 2% HP per second to allies in range. After 3s of continuous casting, removes negative status effects on self.

ani-water-rush.name: Water Rush
ani-water-rush.desc: Fires a water jet. Hold the skill key to continuously cast, dealing damage to enemies in range and stealing up to 2 Energy per second from targets. Also restores 2% HP per second to Water element allies in range.

ani-lightning-surge.name: Lightning Surge
ani-lightning-surge.desc: Channels energy to recharge allies. Lightning-type teammates’ basic attack damage increases by 27%, and their BREAK efficiency increases by 16% for 20s.

ani-here-comes-the-bubble.name: Here Comes the Bubble
ani-here-comes-the-bubble.desc: Releases a giant bubble, reducing the movement speed of targets within range by 15% and their EP recovery rate by 20%. Also increases the movement speed of allies within range by 15%. Lasts for 15s.

ani-bubble-blast.name: Bubble Blast
ani-bubble-blast.desc: Shoots a bubble in the target direction, knocking targets back and dealing damage, while leaving a bubble behind that lasts 9s. This skill can be cast consecutively, storing up to 3 charges.

ani-crazy-bubbles.name: Crazy Bubbles
ani-crazy-bubbles.desc: Quickly creates 6 bubbles and increases party members’ Water damage by 16% for 30s.

ani-bubbles.name: Bubbles
ani-bubbles.desc: Creates a bubble field. Each time a teammate casts a Water skill inside the field, 1 bubble is generated, up to 6 bubbles. Lasts 15s. Press the skill button again to detonate all bubbles. Each bubble restores 4 EP. After absorbing a puddle, restores an additional 10 EP.

ani-electric-dance-frenzy.name: Electric Dance Frenzy
ani-electric-dance-frenzy.desc: Creates an independent music space and deals damage to the targets within the space, lowering their Lightning resistance by 24% for 30s.

ani-disruptive-current.name: Disruptive Current
ani-disruptive-current.desc: Releases a current of electricity, damaging targets ahead.

ani-charged-geyser.name: Charged Geyser
ani-charged-geyser.desc: Restores 15 Energy and restores 0.8 Energy per second for 12s.

ani-beat-of-passion.name: Beat of Passion
ani-beat-of-passion.desc: Keeps playing, sending sound waves forward to damage targets.

ani-lightning-storm.name: Lightning Storm
ani-lightning-storm.desc: Spins upside down on its head at high speed, creating a massive lightning storm. During the skill, deals 12 hits of damage to targets in range, and each hit applies 1 stack of [Lightning Debuff]. The user can move while casting.

ani-lightning-break.name: Lightning Break
ani-lightning-break.desc: Attacks the targets while break dancing.

ani-thunder-sweep.name: Thunder Sweep
ani-thunder-sweep.desc: Performs a rapid spinning kick, dealing area damage and pulling in nearby targets in front of the user. Increases the entire team’s CRIT Rate for Lightning damage by 20% for 20s.

ani-electricity-shock.name: Electricity Shock
ani-electricity-shock.desc: Curls into a ball and dashes at the target, dealing damage and applying 5 stacks of Lightning Debuff. If the target has more than 5 stacks of Lightning Debuff after being hit, applies [Paralysis] for 5s.

ani-thunder-lance.name: Thunder Lance
ani-thunder-lance.desc: Deals multiple hits to targets in a straight line. Targets hit will be [paralyzed] for 3s.

ani-lightning-blade-storm.name: Lightning Blade Storm
ani-lightning-blade-storm.desc: After dashing to close in on the target, it continuously consumes Energy to perform consecutive slashes. When Energy is depleted or clicked again, it unleashes a Spinning Slash that deals 26 Might damage. For every 3 consecutive slashes accumulated by this skill, the final Spinning Slash deals 100% increased damage.

ani-lightning-blade-impact.name: Lightning Blade Impact
ani-lightning-blade-impact.desc: Hold to enter Aim Mode and fire two Electric Blade Shock Waves. Critical hits inflict [Paralysis] on the target for 6s.

ani-enhanced-lightning-blade.name: Enhanced Lightning Blade
ani-enhanced-lightning-blade.desc: Enhances the blade, increasing skill Crit Rate by 35% for 20s.

ani-enhanced-light-blade.name: Enhanced Light Blade
ani-enhanced-light-blade.desc: Grants the blade Light Elemental Boost, increasing skill Crit Rate by 35% for 20s.

ani-keep-the-fire-bolt-going.name: Keep the Fire Bolt Going!
ani-keep-the-fire-bolt-going.desc: Passion Heats Up, dealing AoE Damage and increasing nearby allied units' Fire Elemental Boost by 25%% for 30 seconds

ani-inspiration.name: Inspiration
ani-inspiration.desc: Ignites flames to inspire the whole team, increasing team Fire Damage by 15% for 12s.

ani-treat-feed.name: Treat Feed
ani-treat-feed.desc: Pulls out food to heal the team for 8% of the Sparkelf’s HP. If the unit’s HP is below 50%/25%, instead heals them for 12%/16% of the Sparkelf’s HP.

ani-leaping-sparks.name: Leaping Sparks
ani-leaping-sparks.desc: Hurls an empowered fireball that explodes on impact, dealing area damage and causing affected targets to take 100% increased damage while shielded for 20s.

ani-spark-energy.name: Spark Energy
ani-spark-energy.desc: Hurls an empowered fireball that explodes on impact, dealing area damage and inflicting 2 stacks of [Fire Debuff].

ani-selene-s-judgment.name: Selene’s Judgment
ani-selene-s-judgment.desc: Unleashes Selene’s Judgment on nearby targets, dealing massive damage, evolves into Fennelun, and increases its Damage Amp by 15% until combat ends. Also gains 4 stacks of Silvermoon Mark.

ani-moon-impact.name: Moon Impact
ani-moon-impact.desc: Drops a full moon onto the target, triggering an explosion and dealing damage. If it hits a target with [Fox Mark], deals additional small-area damage around the target equal to 10%.

ani-moon-washed.name: Moon-Washed
ani-moon-washed.desc: Bathes in moonlight and recovers 20 EP.

ani-lunar-eclipse.name: Lunar Eclipse
ani-lunar-eclipse.desc: Pours the power of moonlight onto the target, dealing massive additional BREAK damage based on the Aniimo’s level.

ani-lumin-bolts.name: Lumin Bolts
ani-lumin-bolts.desc: Fires 3 Light missiles at targets, prioritizing different targets. Applies [Fox Mark] to targets hit, reducing their Light Resistance by 5%. Stacks up to 3 times and lasts 10s.

ani-helios-judgment.name: Helios’ Judgment
ani-helios-judgment.desc: Unleashes Helios’ Judgment on nearby targets, dealing massive damage. Evolves into Soleon, increases its own Damage Amp by 15% until leaving combat, and gains  Ring of the Golden Sun.

ani-light-bombardment.name: Light Bombardment
ani-light-bombardment.desc: Dives from the air at the target, causing a Holy Light explosion upon landing. If you have Ring of the Golden Sun, this damage is increased by 30%.

ani-holy-roar.name: Holy Roar
ani-holy-roar.desc: Unleashes a lion’s roar imbued with holy power to attack targets. On hit, increases the user’s Light Damage Amp by 6%, stacking up to 3 times for 20s. [Solar Halo] enhances this skill’s effect, applying 3 stacks each time.

ani-sun-kissed.name: Sun-Kissed
ani-sun-kissed.desc: Bathes in sunlight and restores 20 EP. [Solar Halo] enhances the skill, restoring an extra 5 EP.

ani-holy-storm.name: Holy Storm
ani-holy-storm.desc: Spins and leaps into the air, whipping up a storm that pulls targets toward its center while dealing high BREAK damage based on the Aniimo’s level. [Solar Halo] enhances the skill effect, with the final hit inflicting an additional 1s of stun.
